messages:
Omar: Hey team — POC for VegaMed can't finish onboarding. SAML login errors and SCIM provisioning 403. Need a quick presales triage.
Priyanka: Which deployment? Hosted or Dedicated/VPC?
Omar: Dedicated (tenant `vega-01`) on our EU region. They used Okta.
Zoe: Common pattern: Okta app misconfigured (SP vs IdP metadata swapped) -> SAML Audience/ACS mismatch. For SCIM 403 check whether the client sends X-Tenant-ID; Dedicated requires it.
Omar: Customer logs: `POST /scim/v2/Users 403 Authorization: Bearer <tok> Content-Type: application/json` and gateway shows `401 missing x-tenant-id` then `403 invalid_scope`.
Priyanka: Looks like two issues: header missing + token missing `scim:write` scope. Security can issue a short-lived token scoped to scim if needed.
Zoe: For SAML, ask them to download our SP metadata and upload it into Okta as the Service Provider. If they uploaded their IdP metadata into our console by mistake, that'll flip ACS/Audience. Ask for the raw Assertion (or use SAML-tracer).
Omar: Sent them a tiny validation snippet to run from an infra box.
Omar: ```bash
# validate SCIM path + header
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: vega-01" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" \
  https://eu.api.redwood-inference.com/dedicated/vega-01/scim/v2/Users
# extract NameID from saml_response.xml
xmllint --xpath 'string(//Assertion/Subject/NameID)' saml_response.xml
```
Priyanka: If Okta's provisioning connector strips headers and they can't add custom headers, suggest using the tenant-in-path SCIM URL (we accept tenant in path) or run a tiny sidecar proxy that injects X-Tenant-ID. Also fallback to hosted tenant to demo quickly.
Omar: They ran curl with X-Tenant-ID and still got `403 {"error":"invalid_scope"}`. Priyanka, can security issue the scoped POC token?
Priyanka: Approved. I'll create `scim-poc-vega` (valid 10h) with scim:write only and note IP allowlist exceptions if needed.
infra-bot: created ephemeral hosted fallback `tenant-hosted-vega-demo` and attached temporary scim token (24h).
Zoe: Final checklist I'll DM them: 1) Upload our SP metadata into Okta app (check EntityID/ACS exact match). 2) Ensure NameID claim present (format email). 3) Use SCIM URL with tenant in path or add X-Tenant-ID header. 4) Use token with scim:write. 5) If behind proxy/gateway, ensure headers not stripped.
Omar: Customer will try hosted fallback while they reconfigure Okta. I'll update thread once they confirm success. Thanks :thumbsup:
